Capability Highlights

Eleven vs Plausible: Built for high-growth modern products

Engineered from the ground up for simplicity, instant insights, and total privacy compliance.

Full Revenue Transparency

While Plausible focuses strictly on pageviews, Eleven maps marketing traffic to actual dollars and cents in your bank account.

AI-Powered Natural Language Analytics

Type queries like 'What was our best converting blog post for European users last month?' and get immediate data visualizations.

Deep Visitor Journey Mapping

Understand how users flow from landing pages to signup screens without compromising their privacy or needing full session replay overhead.

Native Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Give your AI coding assistants direct access to conversion data, traffic trends, and error telemetry as you code.

Understand your traffic clearly

Your live traffic, visitor journeys, global reach, and site performance in one dashboard built to help you grow.

Revenue Attribution

Connect every sale back to the page, source, and campaign that earned it, so you know exactly where to invest.
